description.p: Lumina catalogs and manages the photos and videos already on your disk. It has no account, keeps no background network activity, and sends no telemetry.

Browse the library as a justified mosaic or a uniform grid, search by date, place, camera, tags or file name, and collect items into albums and smart albums. Ratings, flags, tags, captions and edits are stored in Lumina's catalog, and metadata can be imported from and written to XMP sidecars.

ul.li: Local catalog with thumbnails and instant timeline seeking
Map of where the photos were taken
Quick edit: rotate, crop, exposure, captions and metadata
Removable libraries: each library's catalog and thumbnails can be deleted without touching the originals
